description: This file defines a custom plugin for the MyPy static type checker, specifically for integrating with SymPy. It provides hooks to enhance type inference related to SymPy's core basic class and free_symbols attribute, and adds attributes representing various assumptions as boolean properties.

classes.name: SympyPlugin
classes.description: A custom MyPy plugin for enhancing type inference with SymPy.

methods.name: get_base_class_hook(self, fullname: str)
methods.description: Provides a hook for when the class 'sympy.core.basic.Basic' is encountered, currently set to return add_assumptions.

methods.name: get_attribute_hook(self, fullname: str)
methods.description: Provides a hook to override the type of 'free_symbols' attribute of SymPy's Basic class to be a set of Symbols.

methods.name: None add_assumptions(ctx)
methods.description: Adds attributes to a class representing various assumptions as boolean properties.

methods.name: plugin(version: str)
methods.description: Entry point function that returns the SympyPlugin class for a given version.
